Aero 1.2.80: tuning that keeps improving.

## Install or update

Aero 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 offer this update at startup (**Update now**). New installs:

| System | File | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows** 10 / 11 (64-bit) | `Aero-windows.zip` | Extract it, double-click `Update-Aero.bat`, accept the admin prompt. `--dest D:\Aero` installs elsewhere; `--lean` skips setting up the integrations now (Aero finishes them in the background). |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `Aero-macos.zip` | Unzip it, right-click `Install-Aero.command` → Open. |
| **Linux**, any distro | `install.sh` | `curl -fsSL https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/releases/latest/download/install.sh \| sh` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `aero_1.2.80_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./aero_1.2.80_all.deb` |
| Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma, openSUSE | `aero-1.2.80-1.noarch.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./aero-1.2.80-1.noarch.rpm` |
| Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS | `PKGBUILD` | `makepkg -si` |
| Any Linux, by hand | `Aero-linux.tar.gz` | `sh Aero/install.sh` |

Models, chats, memory, settings, keys, tunings, skills and mods carry over.

## What's new

- **Warm start.** A tune starts from this model's last tuning (or another quant's on the same GPU), so a re-tune
  needs fewer trials.
- **Background tuning.** While your PC is idle and plugged in, Aero tunes the loaded model one depth deeper (Short →
  Medium → Long).
  - A message stops it at once; the model comes back with its saved tuning.
  - Both are in *Settings → Model & tuning*.

Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/CHANGELOG.md).
